newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent ends up, testing technical levels.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent ends up, testing technical levels.

text.p: Brent crude futures in Asia ended higher on Monday, raising prices to their highest level since early April.
June ended at $19.00 per barrel, up seven cents from London which settled on Friday at $18.93.
Brokers said the front month was now pressing towards a test of $19.09, the level at which prices broke down on April 2 to a lower trading range of $17.50/$18.75.
Traders said news that some OPEC members agreed they should take action to bolster prices helped support the market.
Over the weekend, OPEC President Abdullah Salem Al-Badri and six other ministers met in Iran and agreed oil markets were over supplied and that they should take action.
The move higher was underpinned by NYMEX June crude on ACCESS, where the front month last traded at $20.58, up 15 cents from New York on Friday.
